run_update_artifacts_cli: run the python module to update benchmark artifacts from input_dir to output_dir using argparse CLI
run_copy_benchmark_reports: run copy_benchmark_reports to copy ab_report.csv files from each model subdir in input to output
run_update_new_report: run update_new_report to add a new benchmark report and optionally delete the oldest one
run_update_artifacts_func: run update_artifacts to manage a rolling window of 30 benchmark report artifacts
refactor_update_artifacts_window: refactor update_artifacts to support a configurable WINDOW_LEN instead of the hardcoded value of 30
